gaps.lead: I regret not bringing an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + subject + had + participle.

gaps.lead: I'd love to be able to afford a bigger flat.
gaps.explanation: wish + subject + could expresses regret about ability or possibility.

gaps.lead: The soup needed a little more salt.
gaps.explanation: needed a little more = didn't have enough (salt).

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.
